en.about-me-description: My name is Ash, I am a 22 year old student and indie game developer working on projects like 'Alchemical Adventures', and 'The Monument Of Souls' - the former being a TTRPG, and the latter being a VR-RPG.  for more information on either of these visit my Projects page.
